title: 第九章 载歌载舞第十章 十全汤方
content_zh:
和谈过去数日，便见到大批大批的物资不断的向着高山村里面运输，吃的喝的用的甚至还有孩子玩的东西，数不胜数。
高山村最多大几十户人家。
把所有人都挑吧挑吧也就一二百人数，这些物资只是拿出来的部分，就够他们潇潇洒洒吃一年的。
而这些只是表面上的东西。
或者说吃的对于高山村的这些人来说是最重要的，但是对于那几个老棒子来说，却是最为浅显的东西。
但无论当初谈的是什么，要了什么东西，如今家家户户都能炖上猪肉，牛肉，家家都有糖，盐，还有数不清的粮食。
只是这一项就足以让族人开心。
村子里罕见的烧起了大锅，村中央熬着的那几口大锅底下被青壮年在底下烧上了油松树，噼里啪啦的响声，连带着锅里的油脂在整个大山中飘荡。
小孩子高兴的吃着嘴里的糖，圆的扁的方的正的，粘稠的稀疏的，各种各样的糖果都在他们的兜里揣着。
这些小子们自生下来吃过最甜的东西就是麦芽糖，哪怕如此，这糖也不知传过多少代，只有麦子真发芽了家里才舍得弄那么点糖存起来。
骤然间得了这么多糖，小孩子们小心的打开一个小面的纸袋放在嘴里轻轻舔拭一下，随着又再放回去，舍不得吃，只是一味的看着，哪怕他们手中兜里揣着好多。
原本提刀跨枪，手持钢叉，连带着以前埋伏在屋里的那几杆鸟铳，此刻都已经被扔回了仓库压在了石头底下。
你不说我不说，谁都不知道。
所有人闻着这香味儿，坐在这里聊着家常，双眼之中充斥着对未来的期待。
傍晚，太阳下山，晚上的篝火中闪烁着红色的火光，照在人们的脸上，让这些姑娘媳妇壮汉小孩儿显得更加开怀。
老人打开埋在地下的老酒，连带着外界送进来的新酒一起混装起来，让沉寂了不知道多少年的老村子骤然的活了过来。
就在这样的环境之中。
宋风连带着两个小徒弟走了过来，随即便挥了挥手让这两个小子一起进去，陪着那些小家伙壮汉去玩闹。
打拳的打拳，摔跤的摔跤。
这汉子虽说在大山之中顿顿没法吃好的，但大山中的汉子有的是力气和血性。

老二宋志最喜欢的就是热闹。
只是这一会儿的功夫，便已经将道袍退了下来，只露出里衣与几个汉子在那掰手腕摔跤。
虽然老二年纪不大，但从小练出来的筋骨，宋风从小喂养出来的根骨，竟让他小小年纪也在那群大人之中不落下风。
老大宋诚坐在篝火边，看着玩闹的众人脸上带着一番笑意，老大喜静喜欢看些古书，沉浸入自己的世界之中。
如今人人处在热闹之中，他倒没拿出那几本老书观看，反而呼吸吐纳，认真的将自己心肺之中的沉着淘换出来。
祖师爷传下来的老法子虽然比不上周天混元吐纳术，但终归也是有点真东西，练上十几年，胸中吐气发气也与常人不同。
老大的气息肉眼可见的绵长。
甚至若有若无，丝丝缕缕，好像看不出他在呼吸一般。
content_en:
A few days after the peace talks, we saw large quantities of supplies being continuously transported to the mountain village, including countless food, drink, and even things for children to play with.
There are at most dozens of households in Gaoshan Village.
If we pick everyone, there will only be one or two hundred people. These supplies are only the part that is taken out, which is enough for them to live comfortably for a year.
And these are just things on the surface.
In other words, food is the most important thing to these people in Alpine Village, but to those old sticks, it is the most superficial thing.
But no matter what we talked about at the beginning or what we asked for, now every household can stew pork and beef, and every household has sugar, salt, and countless grains.
This alone is enough to make the tribe happy.
A rare big pot was set up in the village. Young men burned pitch pine trees under the big pots in the center of the village. The crackling sound and the fat in the pots floated throughout the mountains.
The children happily ate the candies in their mouths, round, flat, square, sticky, and sparse. All kinds of candies were carried in their pockets.
The sweetest thing these boys have ever eaten since they were born is maltose. Even so, this sugar has been passed down for countless generations. Only when the wheat has really sprouted will the family be willing to get so much sugar and save it.
Suddenly receiving so much candy, the children carefully opened a small paper bag, put it in their mouths, licked it gently, and then put it back again. They were reluctant to eat it and just stared at it, even though they had a lot in their pockets.
He was originally carrying a knife and a gun, holding a steel fork, and the few blunderbuss that were previously ambushed in the house, but now they have been thrown back into the warehouse and pressed under the rocks.
If you don’t tell me and I don’t tell, no one will know.
Everyone smelled the fragrance and sat here chatting about home affairs, their eyes filled with expectations for the future.
In the evening, the sun goes down, and the red firelight shines in the evening bonfire, shining on people's faces, making these girls, wives, strong men and children look even happier.
The old man opened the old wine buried underground and mixed it with the new wine sent in from the outside world, making the old village that had been silent for who knows how many years suddenly come to life.
In such an environment.
Song Feng came over with his two young apprentices, and then waved his hands to let the two boys go in together to play with the little brawny men.
Punch for punch, wrestling for wrestling.
Although this man can't eat well in the mountains, men in the mountains are full of strength and blood.
What Song Zhi, the second oldest, likes most is excitement.
In just a moment, he had already taken off his Taoist robe, leaving only his inner clothes exposed and wrestling with a few men.
Although the second child is not very old, the muscles he has trained since he was a child and the bones Song Feng has raised since he was a child have allowed him to not fall behind among the adults at such a young age.
The eldest son, Song Cheng, was sitting by the bonfire, looking at the people having fun with a smile on his face. The eldest son, happy Jing, liked to read some ancient books and immerse himself in his own world.
Nowadays, everyone is in the midst of excitement, but he did not take out those old books to read. Instead, he breathed in and out, earnestly trying to regain the composure in his heart and lungs.
Although the old method passed down by the ancestor is not as good as Zhou Tian's Hunyuan Breathing Technique, it is still somewhat real. After practicing it for more than ten years, the breathing and breathing in the chest are different from ordinary people.
The boss's breath was visibly long.
There were even traces of presence and absence, as if he couldn't be seen breathing.
